Gastrointestinal Drug Groups Antacids Antacids are basic compounds that neutralise hydrochloric acid in the gastric secretions. They are used in the sympto- matic management of gastrointestinal disorders associated with gastric hyperacidity such as dyspepsia, gastro- oesophageal reflux disease, and peptic ulcer disease (see below). Antacids do not reduce the volume of hydrochloric acid secreted and elevation of the gastric pH may actually pro- mote an increase in acid secretion.
